concept: Review and integration: craftsmanship as pride in quality, wherever it's applied
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across redoing 'good enough' work, deliberate practice, and respecting skilled trades — what's your personal view of quality work?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real skill or project where this Pillar would apply to them

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
